scope: Outcome-blind sequential execution of the resource-heavy task remaining in the compatible frozen Wave 1 and Wave 2 panel

checkpoint_design.selection_rule: Run every remaining frozen Wave 1 and Wave 2 task except the preregistered infrastructure-incompatible MCTS task; split execution only by declared sandbox resources.
checkpoint_design.revision_reason: This build task declares 4 CPUs and 8 GiB, matching the resource shape that provisions reliably one sandbox at a time.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: four sequential Harbor trials followed by a zero-sandbox cleanup check

interpretation_guard: Complete the task before changing the router or selecting follow-on data. Infrastructure failures remain excluded and are recovered route-for-route.
